column1: # CodeRabbit findings deliberately deferred out of a PR into their own issue.
# ops/pr_gate.sh reads this to keep a PR's gate from being held hostage by a
# finding that has been triaged and tracked elsewhere. It does NOT hide them:
# every deferral is listed in the PR comment with its issue, and the commit
# status says how many were deferred. An entry is a decision on the record —
# it needs a real Linear id and a reason someone can argue with.
# RESOLVED 2026-09-02: KCH-71 fixed by hand on development once KCH-51 merged.
# Kept as the record of the decision — the gate no longer needs it, KCH-51 is merged.

column5: Path filter omits pyproject.toml/uv.lock, so a dependency-only PR does not schedule the eval. Latent until GROQ_API_KEY is live; failure mode is a missed trigger, not a wrong result. Deferred to end a five-round loop that was gating PRs #16-#19 and everything stacked above them.
